description: Commission of Elections - Elected Mr. Nongamu Vithanalage Samantha as a member of the North Central Provincial Council from the Administrative District of Polonnaruwa
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the filling of a vacancy in a Provincial Council due to the death of a member. It details the process of nomination by a political party and the subsequent declaration by the Election Commission that a new member has been elected. The content is exclusively focused on an electoral process, specifically the procedure for filling a casual vacancy, as outlined in the Provincial Councils Elections Act.
